chen-sheng-wu-guang-revolt.description: A crowd of shouting, mud-spattered men in plain dark tunics and cloth headbands charge through heavy rain, raising long bamboo-shafted spears, hoes and sickles. In the lower left a torn yellow-and-maroon banner with a dark geometric pattern lies in muddy water. The background shows more figures with raised tools under a stormy grey sky, with reeds and a flooded field.

boudica-revolt.description: A red-haired woman in a tartan dress and cloak with a torc stands in a wicker two-horse chariot, raising a long spear. Blue-painted warriors with round shields and spears run beside her. Behind them, half-timbered tiled-roof houses burn under a smoky sky. Edge to edge, no text or frame; only a tiny cropped mark in the bottom corner.

zanj-rebellion-begins.description: A muscular barefoot man in a ragged loincloth raises a spear overhead in one hand and grips a long wooden-handled tool in the other, standing in muddy, salt-crusted ground. Several other men dig or hold spears in the midground, with thatched huts, palm trees, smoke and a distant fire behind them. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text, frame or border.

pilgrimage-of-grace-rising.description: A painterly procession of peasants, women and a monk in a dark habit marches across a moorland under stormy skies, led by a man holding a large crimson banner showing hands, feet and a heart over a chalice, with small red drips on the hands and feet. A smoky abbey stands behind. Tudor-era dress. No text, no frame, no border.

pueblo-revolt-spanish-expelled.description: A shirtless man with long dark hair and a feather headband stands on the edge of an adobe rooftop, holding a drawn bow with an arrow nocked. Behind him in the valley a pale mission church with two bell towers is on fire, with thick smoke rising into a dark, stormy sky. Low adobe buildings and distant hills fill the background, and the scene is lit by a dim orange sunset. The painting is an oil-style image that fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text.

pugachev-rebellion.description: A bearded man in a dark fur hat and dark coat rides a black horse, one arm stretched forward in command. Behind him a crowd of men in peasant coats and fur hats carry scythes, pikes and muskets. In the background a wooden log fort with watchtowers sits on a hill, with smoke and fire rising, under a heavy grey stormy sky. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge. No visible wounds or blood.

tupac-amaru-ii-rebellion.description: A man in a dark coat with gold-embroidered red sash and a tricorn hat rides a dark horse, pointing forward. Behind him a crowd of people in ponchos, woolen caps and shawls raise staffs and tools. Stepped stone terraces climb the hillside on the left, a white church with a bell tower sits on a hill at right, and a stormy sky hangs over mountains. No visible text, no frame, edge-to-edge painting.

zapatista-uprising-chiapas.description: A central masked figure in a black knit balaclava and red neckerchief holds a rifle across the frame, with several other masked and bandana-covered people carrying old rifles and a stick behind him. The setting is a colonial-style town square with arcaded buildings on the left and a large white facade on the right, under a grey dawn sky. The style is a painted oil look with no visible text, signature or border.
